a.lede: US cybersecurity company F5 warned customers to patch five critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit to trigger denial-of-service (DoS) or gain remote code execution. [...]
a.title: F5 releases emergency patches for critical BIG-IP RCE flaws

b.lede: GL.iNet has confirmed that hackers exploited a vulnerability in its cloud remote management services to install custom malware on customers' routers and KVM devices, with some affected users reporting backdoors and reverse shells giving remote access to infected devices. [...]
b.title: Hackers exploit GL.iNet cloud flaw to infect routers, KVM devices
